_comment: Social signal settings. YouTube needs the YOUTUBE_API_KEY repository secret. The free YouTube quota is 10,000 units/day; one search costs 100 units, so searchesPerRun x runs per day (48) x 100 must stay under 10,000.

tiktok.reason: TikTok has no public API for trend or hashtag data (its Research API is limited to approved academic researchers).
